about_the_game:
The year is 1956. The Second World War is over, but the nightmare isn’t finished.
Across the globe, escaped nazi officers follow secret “rat lines,” plotting the rebirth of the Reich through dark science and forbidden occult rites.

You play as the daughter of a French Resistance fighter - a woman raised in a shadow of war, trained in both survival and subterfuge. From the steaming jungles of South America to the endless Antarctic ice, you will track fugitives, infiltrate covert bases, and uncover a conspiracy that stretches beyond Earth itself.

Key Features

  • Fast-Paced 2D Action – Classic side-scrolling gunplay with tight controls, fluid movement, and satisfying combat.

  • Global Adventure – Explore striking locations: hidden Argentine villages, frozen Arctic outposts, secret submarine pens, and even the desolate landscapes of the Moon.

  • Deep Narrative – Uncover a web of espionage and occult science as you pursue war criminals and piece together the plan for a “Fourth Reich.”

  • Weapons & Upgrades – Master vintage 1950s firearms and experimental tech recovered from enemy labs.

  • Atmospheric Presentation – Hand-crafted pixel art, dynamic lighting, and a tense original soundtrack bring every setting to life.

  • Full Controller Support – Play comfortably with gamepad or keyboard.

The Mission

Decades after the war, evil still hides in the shadows.
Follow the rat lines, cut them off at the source, and end the dream of a New Reich—before it escapes to the stars.

Rat Lines delivers a gripping mix of retro shooter action and adventure storytelling, perfect for players who love fast combat, mystery, and cinematic world-building.

short_description: Rat Lines is a 2D action-adventure shooter set in 1956. Hunt down escaped Nazi criminals and stop their plan to build a new Reich. Travel from the jungles of Argentina to the icy Arctic, infiltrate secret submarines, and even assault nazi bases on the Moon!
